submission.notes: Repurposed 2 near-dead layer-5 FFN neurons (2120,1068) as a gated circuit on the CLS token: lin1 rows = A*gate +/- B*sign, where gate = closed-form ridge probe for 'negated template sentence' (plus a template-vs-real-review term) and sign = ridge readout of correct sentiment trained on negated sentences; lin2 columns = +/- a positive-sentiment direction in the residual. Fit on dev plus 50 self-written implicit/explicit/affirmative phrasings; no gradients.
